_notes: Boston sports historical facts for Dan's color references and humor comparisons. Hand-curated, every entry verifiable. Comprehensive coverage from 1980s through present. The humor_angle field suggests how Dan might use each moment in a comparison or story.

championships.note: Banner 18, Tatum's first ring, Jaylen Brown Finals MVP
The Big Three's one and only, Pierce Finals MVP
Larry Bird era apex, widely considered greatest Celtics team ever
Bird vs Magic Finals round 1, the 'Heat Game' in the old Garden
Russell's 11th and final ring as player-coach

dynasties.name: Russell Era
dynasties.note: 11 titles in 13 years, Bill Russell never cared about stats

dynasties.name: Big Three
dynasties.note: Pierce, Garnett, Allen, 1 title but always a threat

iconic_moments.moment: Jaylen Brown named Finals MVP as Celtics win Banner 18 in dominant fashion over Dallas
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan watched with three generations of family, his kid asked if the Celtics always win

iconic_moments.moment: Celtics reach the Finals for first time since 2010, lose to Warriors in 6 games
iconic_moments.humor_angle: So close you could taste it, then Steph happened

iconic_moments.moment: Jayson Tatum's buzzer-beater to beat the Raptors in the bubble playoffs
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Nobody was in the arena but Dan screamed so loud his neighbors called

iconic_moments.moment: Isaiah Thomas plays through grief after his sister's death, scores 53 against the Wizards in the playoffs
iconic_moments.humor_angle: One of the most gutsy performances Dan has ever seen, IT4 left everything on the floor

iconic_moments.moment: LeBron eliminates the Celtics in Game 7 of the ECF, ending the Big Three era
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan still gets a twitch when someone mentions South Beach

iconic_moments.moment: Celtics blow the Finals to the Lakers in Game 7, Kobe wins his 5th ring at Boston's expense
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan walked home past the Common and saw a guy in a Garnett jersey staring at nothing

iconic_moments.moment: KG screams 'Anything is possible!' after winning Banner 17
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan's pops, who never gets emotional about sports, walked out of the room and came back with red eyes

iconic_moments.moment: Paul Pierce leaves the game in a wheelchair in the Finals, returns and hits a three
iconic_moments.humor_angle: The wheelchair game. Dan thought it was over. Pierce had other ideas.

iconic_moments.moment: Ray Allen's clutch shooting buries the Lakers in the Finals
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan was in the nosebleeds at the Garden and felt every three through the floor

iconic_moments.moment: Celtics reach the ECF for first time in years, lose to the Nets. Pierce-Walker era revival
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Brief hope before the dark years

iconic_moments.moment: Reggie Lewis collapses during a playoff game, later dies in the offseason. Franchise-altering tragedy
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Not for humor. Dan mentions this only with reverence. A loss that transcended basketball.

iconic_moments.moment: Larry Bird retires due to chronic back pain after 13 seasons
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan's pops said the Garden got quieter the day Bird retired and never got that loud again until 2008

iconic_moments.moment: Bird steals the inbounds pass from Isiah Thomas in Game 5 of the ECF, feeds DJ for the layup
iconic_moments.humor_angle: The steal. Dan's pops acted it out in the living room so many times he knocked over a lamp.

iconic_moments.moment: Len Bias, 2nd overall pick, dies of cocaine overdose two days after being drafted. Dynasty that never was
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Not for humor. The biggest what-if in franchise history. Dan mentions this with respect only.

iconic_moments.moment: The 1985-86 Celtics go 67-15, widely considered the greatest team in franchise history
iconic_moments.humor_angle: When Dan's pops says 'you should've seen the '86 team,' he means it

iconic_moments.moment: The Heat Game: Game 5 of the Finals at Boston Garden with no air conditioning, 97 degrees at tipoff
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan's pops claims he was there and survived on sheer willpower and a warm Coke

collapses.event: Celtics blow 3-1 series lead to 76ers in first round, eliminated as 2-seed
collapses.humor_angle: Too fresh to be funny. Dan is still processing.

collapses.event: Celtics lose Game 7 of ECF to Heat at home after being heavy favorites
collapses.humor_angle: Dan had the parade route bookmarked on his phone. Had to delete the bookmark.

collapses.event: Celtics blow Finals lead to Lakers, lose Game 7 at home
collapses.humor_angle: Perkins' injury, Kobe's smirk, Dan's broken remote control

rivalries.note: 12 Finals meetings, defines the NBA. Bird vs Magic, Pierce vs Kobe, the rivalry that built the league.
Bird vs Doctor J, modern Tatum vs Embiid, 2026 first-round upset still stings
Playoff nemesis through the 2010s and 2020s, LeBron's villain era, Butler's dominance

championships.note: Thomas Conn Smythe, Game 7 shutout in Vancouver
Orr and Esposito in their prime
Orr's flying goal, the iconic photo

dynasties.name: Big Bad Bruins
dynasties.note: Orr, Esposito, Bucyk, physical and dominant

dynasties.name: Neely-Bourque Era
dynasties.note: Cam Neely's physicality, Bourque's leadership, heartbreak but beloved

iconic_moments.moment: Record-setting 65-win regular season (133 points) ends with first-round elimination by Panthers in 7 games
iconic_moments.humor_angle: The most dominant regular season in NHL history and it meant absolutely nothing in April

iconic_moments.moment: Bergeron and Marchand partnership era, Bruins a perennial playoff team but couldn't get past the second round
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Always the bridesmaid, never the bride, unless you count 2011

iconic_moments.moment: Bruins reach the Stanley Cup Final, lose to Blues in 7 games. No goal controversy in Game 5
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan is still mad about that hand pass. Rick next door wrote a 3-page letter to the league.

iconic_moments.moment: Bruins blow 2-1 lead in the Cup Final, Blackhawks score twice in 17 seconds in Game 6 to win it
iconic_moments.humor_angle: 17 seconds. Dan was celebrating. Then he wasn't. The fastest heartbreak in sports history.

iconic_moments.moment: Tim Thomas posts a .940 save percentage in the playoffs, shutout in Game 7 of the Cup Final
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Thomas was a brick wall. Dan watched at Uncle Carmine's place. Carmine slept through the second period.

iconic_moments.moment: Bruins become only the 3rd team in NHL history to blow a 3-0 series lead, losing to Flyers in 7 games
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan told everyone at work the Bruins were a lock after Game 3. Called in sick after Game 7.

iconic_moments.moment: Joe Thornton wins Hart Trophy then gets traded to San Jose. Beginning of a rebuild.
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Trading your best player is a special kind of pain. Dan still thinks about what could've been.

iconic_moments.moment: Ray Bourque traded to Colorado after 21 years in Boston, finally wins the Cup in 2001
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan cried when Bourque lifted the Cup in an Avalanche jersey. Happy tears, but still. Should've been in black and gold.

iconic_moments.moment: Cam Neely retires at 31 due to chronic knee injuries. One of the great what-ifs.
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Neely healthy for a full career is 600 goals easy. Dan's pops still gets mad about the Ulf Samuelsson hit.

iconic_moments.moment: Bruins' last season at the old Boston Garden before moving to the Fleet Center
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan's pops took him to the last game at the old Garden. Says the new place never smelled right.

iconic_moments.moment: Bruins reach the Cup Final, lose to Penguins (Lemieux) in 4 games. Outclassed by greatness.
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Nothing you can do when Mario Lemieux decides he's the best player on earth that week

iconic_moments.moment: Bruins reach the Cup Final for first time since 1978, lose to Edmonton in 5 games with a power failure at Boston Garden in Game 4
iconic_moments.humor_angle: The lights literally went out at the Garden during a Cup Final game. You can't make this stuff up.

iconic_moments.moment: Bruins-Canadiens playoff brawl and power failure at Montreal Forum during Game 4 of the Adams Division Final
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Original Six hockey at its finest, or worst, depending on who you ask

collapses.event: Bruins eliminated in first round by Buffalo Sabres 4-2
collapses.humor_angle: Buffalo. Of all teams. Dan needs time.

collapses.event: Historic 65-win season ends in first-round exit to Florida Panthers
collapses.humor_angle: Best regular season ever, worst possible ending. Dan's blood pressure hasn't recovered.

collapses.event: Blew 3-0 series lead to Flyers, only 3rd team in NHL history to collapse that badly
collapses.humor_angle: Dan told everyone at work it was over after Game 3. Called in sick after Game 7.

rivalries.note: Original Six, most playoff meetings in NHL history
Playoff nemesis, Bruins own the recent head-to-head
New rivalry born from 2023 first-round upset after record season

championships.note: 108-win juggernaut, Mookie Betts MVP season, Steve Pearce WS MVP
Boston Strong after the Marathon bombing, Ortiz WS MVP
Papi and Manny still rolling, Pedroia ROY, dominant sweep
Broke the 86-year curse, came back from 0-3 vs the Yankees in ALCS

curses_and_droughts.name: Curse of the Bambino
curses_and_droughts.note: 86-year title drought after selling Babe Ruth to the Yankees

dynasties.name: Papi Era
dynasties.note: 3 titles, Ortiz became the face of Boston

dynasties.name: 2018 Machine
dynasties.note: 108-54, best record in MLB, bulldozed through October

iconic_moments.moment: Kiké Hernandez's walk-off sacrifice fly in ALDS vs Rays, grand slam in ALCS vs Astros
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Kiké was a one-man wrecking crew in October. Dan couldn't sit down for the entire ALCS.

iconic_moments.moment: Red Sox win 108 games and dominate the postseason, Mookie Betts at his peak
iconic_moments.humor_angle: That team was so good even Sully's predictions came true for once

iconic_moments.moment: Ortiz hits go-ahead grand slam in ALCS Game 2 vs Tigers, Torii Hunter flips over the bullpen wall
iconic_moments.humor_angle: The grand slam. The bullpen cop's face. Dan grabbed a total stranger in a bear hug and his beer went everywhere.

iconic_moments.moment: Red Sox win World Series at Fenway for first time since 1918, Boston Strong season after Marathon bombing
iconic_moments.humor_angle: That season meant more than baseball. Dan's pops said it was the most important championship any Boston team ever won.

iconic_moments.moment: September collapse: Red Sox blow 9-game wild card lead in final month, go 7-20 in September. Worst collapse in MLB history at the time.
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan doesn't talk about September 2011. It's like a family secret. They were in. Then they weren't. 7-and-20.

iconic_moments.moment: Game 162: Orioles walk off against Red Sox while Rays complete miracle comeback. Sox eliminated on final night.
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan watched two TVs at once. Both broke his heart at the exact same time.

iconic_moments.moment: Bobby Valentine era: 69-93 record, worst Red Sox season in decades. Valentine fired after one season.
iconic_moments.humor_angle: The Bobby V year. Dan blocked it from his memory. Sully still brings it up to torture him.

iconic_moments.moment: Manny Ramirez traded mid-season to Dodgers. End of Manny Being Manny in Boston.
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Manny was Manny until he wasn't. Dan was sad but not surprised.

iconic_moments.moment: Red Sox sweep the World Series, Papelbon dances on the mound, second title in 4 years
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Papelbon's Riverdance on the mound. Dan tried to replicate it at a cookout. Nearly broke his ankle.

iconic_moments.moment: Dave Roberts steals second in ALCS Game 4, sparking the greatest comeback in baseball history
iconic_moments.humor_angle: The Steal. Dan was at a bar in Southie. Sully had already left. Then Roberts took off and everything changed.

iconic_moments.moment: Curt Schilling pitches Game 6 of the ALCS with a bloody sock, sutured ankle tendon
iconic_moments.humor_angle: The Bloody Sock. Dan's pops said that's what it looks like when a man refuses to lose.

iconic_moments.moment: Ortiz walk-off homer in ALCS Game 4 and walk-off single in Game 5 vs Yankees
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Big Papi with the city on his back. Dan still gets chills thinking about those at-bats.

iconic_moments.moment: Aaron Boone's walk-off homer in ALCS Game 7 sends Yankees to World Series. Grady Little leaves Pedro in too long.
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Grady Little. Pedro. The 8th inning. Dan threw the remote at the TV and had to buy a new one.

iconic_moments.moment: Pedro Martinez strikes out 17 in one-hitter vs Yankees at Yankee Stadium. 'Who's your daddy?' came later, but this was the night Pedro was God.
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan watched with his pops. Pops said he'd never seen anything like it. He was right.

iconic_moments.moment: Pedro Martinez ALDS Game 5 relief appearance vs Indians, pitches 6 no-hit innings on 3 days rest
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Pedro came out of the bullpen and threw six innings of zeros. On three days' rest. In a do-or-die game.

iconic_moments.moment: Bill Buckner lets the grounder go through his legs in Game 6 of the World Series
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Not for humor. Dan's pops told the story so many times it feels like a memory. The ball, the legs, the silence.

iconic_moments.moment: Roger Clemens strikes out 20 batters in a single game vs Seattle, first pitcher ever to do so
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Before the bad blood, Clemens was untouchable. Twenty K's. Dan's pops called it the greatest game he ever watched.

iconic_moments.moment: Bucky Dent's homer at Fenway in the one-game playoff, Yankees win the AL East
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan's family has a different middle name for Bucky Dent. They're not the only ones.

iconic_moments.moment: Fisk waves it fair in Game 6 of the World Series vs the Reds
iconic_moments.humor_angle: The wave. Fisk willing the ball fair. Dan's pops says it's the most iconic moment in Fenway history.

collapses.event: Blew 9-game wild card lead in September, went 7-20 to miss playoffs on final day
collapses.humor_angle: The worst September in baseball history. Dan watched two TVs on the last night. Both broke his heart.
The year that shall not be named. Sully still brings it up.

collapses.event: Grady Little leaves Pedro in too long, Aaron Boone ends it in Game 7 of ALCS
collapses.humor_angle: Dan threw the remote at the TV. Had to buy a new TV.

rivalries.note: The rivalry. 100-plus years, defines baseball in the Northeast. Roberts, Boone, Dent, Fisk. Every game matters more.

championships.note: Vinatieri's second walk-off field goal in three years
Brady's first, Tuck Rule changed history

dynasties.name: Brady-Belichick
dynasties.note: 6 rings, 9 Super Bowl appearances, greatest dynasty in NFL history

dynasties.name: Post-Brady Rebuild
dynasties.note: Finding a new identity, Drake Maye era begins

iconic_moments.moment: Patriots reach Super Bowl LX with Drake Maye, lose to Lions. Best post-Brady season at 14-3.
iconic_moments.humor_angle: So close. Maye showed the future is real but the present still hurts.

iconic_moments.moment: Mac Jones rookie season, Patriots make playoffs. Brief hope before regression.
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan was optimistic for about 6 months. A personal record.

iconic_moments.moment: Brady's final game as a Patriot: wild card loss to Titans at home. End of an era.
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan knew it was over when Brady walked off the field. Didn't want to say it out loud.

iconic_moments.moment: Super Bowl LIII: 13-3 win over Rams, lowest scoring Super Bowl ever. Brady's 6th ring.
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Sully fell asleep during the first half. Dan can't blame him. But a win is a win. Six rings.

iconic_moments.moment: Eagles beat Patriots 41-33 in Super Bowl LII. Nick Foles and the Philly Special.
iconic_moments.humor_angle: The Philly Special. Dan still can't watch the replay. Lost to a backup quarterback running a trick play.

iconic_moments.moment: 28-3 comeback in Super Bowl LI vs Falcons, greatest comeback in Super Bowl history
iconic_moments.humor_angle: At 28-3, Sully's wife started cleaning up. Dan refused to leave. Woke Sully up screaming at the start of overtime.

iconic_moments.moment: Malcolm Butler intercepts Russell Wilson at the goal line to win Super Bowl XLIX
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan was on his knees in Sully's living room. The play call. The pick. Dan hugged the TV.

iconic_moments.moment: AFC Championship loss to Broncos. Peyton Manning revenge game.
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Peyton got his. Dan respects it. Doesn't like it, but respects it.

iconic_moments.moment: Patriots lose Super Bowl XLVI to Giants again. Manningham catch echoes Tyree.
iconic_moments.humor_angle: The Giants again. A different miracle catch. Dan seriously considered becoming a hockey-only fan.

iconic_moments.moment: 18-1: Perfect regular season ends with Super Bowl loss to Giants. Tyree's helmet catch.
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan doesn't talk about the helmet catch. He had a Super Bowl party with 40 people. By the 4th quarter there were 3.

iconic_moments.moment: Patriots go 16-0 in the regular season, first undefeated regular season since 1972 Dolphins
iconic_moments.humor_angle: The regular season was a freight train. Then the freight train hit a wall named Eli Manning.

iconic_moments.moment: AFC Championship loss to Colts. Peyton Manning finally beats the Patriots in the playoffs.
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Manning's face when he won. Dan's face when he lost. Two very different expressions.

iconic_moments.moment: Patriots win 21 consecutive games spanning 2003-2004 seasons
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Twenty-one straight. Dan's pops said the dynasty was official. He was right.

iconic_moments.moment: The Tuck Rule game: Brady fumble reversed in snowy AFC Divisional vs Raiders
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan and pops drove to Foxborough in a blizzard. Pops had a thermos of something that was definitely not coffee.

iconic_moments.moment: Drew Bledsoe goes down, unknown 6th-round pick Tom Brady takes over and changes NFL history
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan felt bad for Bledsoe. Then Brady started winning. Dan stopped feeling bad pretty quick.

iconic_moments.moment: Patriots reach Super Bowl XXXI, lose to Packers. Parcells era peak.
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan was just happy to be there. The Pats hadn't been relevant since the '80s.

iconic_moments.moment: Patriots reach Super Bowl XX, get destroyed 46-10 by the Bears. The Fridge scored.
iconic_moments.humor_angle: Dan's pops took him to a Super Bowl party and they left at halftime. The fridge scored a touchdown. An actual refrigerator-sized human.

collapses.event: 18-1. Perfect season ends in Super Bowl loss to Giants on Tyree's helmet catch
collapses.humor_angle: 19-0 T-shirts printed in advance. They're still in someone's garage in Quincy.

collapses.event: Wild card loss to Titans at home, Brady's last game as a Patriot
collapses.humor_angle: The end. Dan knew it. Everyone knew it. Nobody wanted to say it.

collapses.event: Lost Super Bowl LII to Eagles and Nick Foles despite Brady throwing for 505 yards
collapses.humor_angle: Brady threw for 505 yards and lost. Dan has never been more confused by a football game.

rivalries.note: Divisional nemesis, Brady owned them. Belichick's origin story.
Brady vs Manning, era-defining QB duels. The rivalry that defined the 2000s AFC.
Playoff heartbreaks, physical AFC matchup. Ray Lewis, Ed Reed, Suggs.
Two Super Bowl losses, two miracle catches. The one team that had Brady's number.
